top_creatures.label: Stone-hide bruiser
top_creatures.why: Heavy body that takes much less physical damage and gets more defence
top_creatures.keep: modifier stack on one body, visible when active
top_creatures.change: resistance only while standing guard, ends after a short move; not a flat stat

top_creatures.label: Blink-and-mend
top_creatures.why: Warps away when hit and heals while away
top_creatures.keep: warp then heal as one rule
top_creatures.change: one blink per 20 s; healing shown as a breakable wisp orb

top_creatures.label: Leash-linked brood
top_creatures.why: All minions die when the leader dies
top_creatures.change: minions stagger and fall apart over 1.5 s; one spawn slot kept free

top_creatures.label: Shard burst
top_creatures.why: No corpse; body shatters into ice pieces on death
top_creatures.change: short cone of shards, 1.5 s slow, own sound

top_creatures.label: Chill blast
top_creatures.why: Explodes on death and chills nearby fighters
top_creatures.change: slow only in a small ring, not the whole zone

top_creatures.label: Charged-bolt spitter
top_creatures.change: bolts on every third hit only, so the duel stays readable

top_creatures.label: Aura bearer
top_creatures.why: Gets a random offensive aura at spawn
top_creatures.keep: random aura from a list at spawn
top_creatures.change: aura from our three duel auras, shown as a ring under the feet

top_creatures.label: Mana thief
top_creatures.why: Steals mana on hit and heals itself
top_creatures.change: drains stamina, not mana; heals a fixed share

looks.label: Palette transform bank
looks.technique: one base palette plus precomputed remap tables: light levels, inventory variations, three alpha tiers, additive and multiplicative blends, hue variations

looks.label: Unique sprite tint
looks.technique: palette-shift index per unique, applied to held and ground sprite

looks.label: Status tint with priority
looks.technique: colour priority 0-255, palette-shift index and light colour per state; highest priority wins

looks.label: Transparency ladder and modulate
looks.technique: 25, 50, 75 percent alpha offset; modulate uses the lighter composite; burn and modulate-2x are empty cases

looks.label: Hover brightness
looks.technique: brightness push of 2 while hovered or selected

looks.label: Missile flicker
looks.technique: flicker and diameter fields plus a transparency mode per missile

looks.label: Sound fade envelope
looks.technique: fade-in and fade-out per sound in frames, converted to a per-second volume ramp

looks.label: Ambient random pan
looks.technique: one-shot ambient events pick a random stereo pan from -1 to 1

originals.name: Tidewall Guard
originals.idea: An elite that is hard to dent while it holds its ground and loses the cover the moment it steps.
originals.change: reduction comes from a visible guard pose and ends after 0.5 s of movement; ties to parity row 3

originals.name: Lantern Wisp Mender
originals.idea: A caster that blinks a short hop when struck low and heals only while its orb is intact.
originals.change: one blink per 20 s; the orb sits on the ground and a hit can break it

originals.name: Brood Tether
originals.idea: A leader whose minions stagger apart when it falls and keep one spawn slot free.
originals.change: no instant vanish; minions fall over 1.5 s; ties to row 23 spawn caps

originals.name: Glacier Husk
originals.idea: Dies with no corpse and bursts into shards that slow a small ring.
originals.keep: no-corpse death and chill burst (modifiers 33 and 35)
originals.change: slow is local, 1.5 s, with its own sound cue

originals.name: Gilt Relic
originals.idea: Unique gear with one palette-shifted copy and an animated sheen; rarity by affix count.
originals.keep: one tint per unique and count-based rarity (item.go:146)
originals.change: our own ramp and thresholds, a drop sound per tier; ties to row 15
